description:
A product's recorded daily prices over a date range. BasketWatch has kept
    every night's price at Aldi, Tesco, SuperValu and Dunnes Stores since May
    2026 and at Lidl since 17 October 2026, and, with
    with_nutrition_and_ingredients, each day's nutrition per 100g or 100ml and
    ingredients list as the retailer's own data stated them, kept since
    16 October 2026: for questions like "has the sugar in Frosties changed".

    Takes product ids (as returned in product results; an Aldi id has no store
    prefix, and "aldi:" in front of one is accepted) or a query; with a query,
    the closest matching products are looked up first. A range returns one row
    per product per day, and each row costs one credit; with from_date equal
    to to_date, one day's price is returned.

    Every product gets the same days. When products x days would pass the row
    limit, the range is shortened to its most recent days for all of them and
    note says so; ids with no price in the range are listed in not_found.

    Args:
        product_ids: e.g. ["tesco:300793546", "dunnes:100873410",
            "000000000000387044"], up to 50; each id's store is taken from it.
        query: product name words, used when no product_ids are given.
        store: aldi, tesco, supervalu, dunnes or lidl, to narrow a query.
            Leave it out to look in all five.
        from_date: first day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to 30 days before to_date.
        to_date: last day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.
        limit: most rows to return in total (default and maximum 200).
        with_nutrition_and_ingredients: true adds nutrition_per_100 to every
            row and the ingredients list on each product's first day and on
            any day it changed. Days before 16 October 2026 have none.

    Returns rows (id, name, store, scrape_date, price, unit_price, unit_basis,
    clubcard_price, offer_text, was_price), the days covered, not_found, note.
name: get_price_history

clubcard_price.description: Member price that day: Tesco Clubcard, SuperValu Real Rewards or Lidl Plus
clubcard_price.title: Clubcard Price

ingredients.description: The ingredients list, on a product's first day and on any day it changed (with_nutrition_and_ingredients)
ingredients.title: Ingredients

nutrition_per_100.description: That day's nutrition per 100g or 100ml, as the retailer's own data stated it (with_nutrition_and_ingredients)

price.description: Shelf price in euro that day
price.title: Price

scrape_date.description: The day this price was recorded, YYYY-MM-DD
scrape_date.title: Scrape Date

not_found.description: Requested ids with no price recorded in the range: an unknown id, or a product not on sale then
not_found.title: Not Found

note.description: What was left out and why, when anything was
note.title: Note

rows.description: One row per product per day recorded, each product's days in order
rows.title: Rows

title: Price history
